<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
Beginning a deep dive into specific profile issues.

Found several concrete profile bugs and UX gaps. MacroRatioChart hides ERROR states from the UI. ProfileDayMealsPanel omits the "cca" prefix. Health devices appear before the plan section. Calendar shows for START users without trainers. Apple Watch logic duplicates between embedded and connect sections. A separate zdravi.js health page exists. PreferencesOverlay has inert state and plan locking issues. Recipe click handlers have a signature mismatch.

Recipe click handler signatures differ across components. The weekly PlanViewer passes both meal item and event objects to performOpenRecipe. Need to verify whether the recipe modal itself has nutrition honesty issues. Also checking the first-action-banner logic where currentPlan should exist once plan_state reaches ready.

The ready-banner condition `showReadyBanner && !currentPlan` is logically dead. When `plan_state` is ready, `currentPlan` is guaranteed to exist, so the banner text "Tvůj plán je připraven" can never render. This creates contradictory copy and a dead UI path.

ProfileDayMealsPanel omits the "cca" prefix on meal card kcal and likely lacks under-target styling on day totals. On mobile, Apple Watch and ConnectDevices sections render unconditionally, even when disconnected or empty, creating clutter and empty chart trust issues.

Now examining RecoveryCard and HealthConnectionBanner for state bugs. Also checking PreferencesOverlay and scanning for XSS vulnerabilities through dangerouslySetInnerHTML.
</details></think>

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
PreferencesOverlay contains an English UI string ("AI personalization workspace") that indicates a copy or i18n issue. Severity: P2.

Bubble body containers use max-height: 5000px. This risks clipping other sections when content exceeds the limit. The muj-plan section uses max-height: none instead.

Calendar clutter for START users without trainers needs review. Recipe modals may lack portion honesty indicators. sumDayNutrition and daily_achieved_kcal might not consume calorie_honesty day totals. ProfileTodayPanels fails to show under-target kcal states. Health charts render empty data. profil.js is extremely long. English strings persist in preferences.

MacroRatioChart surfaces only warning UI; errors remain hidden from users. ProfileDayMealsPanel displays exact kcal without the "cca" qualifier used in PlanViewer weekly cards, creating a trust inconsistency. ProfileTodayPanels recomputes daily totals via sumDayNutrition rather than using structDay.daily_achieved_kcal directly. When HTML-parsed meals lack nutrition data, sumDayNutrition correctly falls back to struct values.

The calorie honesty banner appears above today panels, yet the today summary cards still display high targets without an "under-target" badge. This creates a P1 honesty gap. Workout duration estimates use an arbitrary formula (`exercises.length * 8`) and appear as approximate minutes, which undermines trust. The recipe detail modal and image trust labels still need inspection.
</details></think>

# Profile / logged-in UX audit — Body & Mind ON

**Profile health score: 5.5 / 10**

Solid foundations (plan-state handling, PlanViewer honesty banner, some `cca` wording, recovery disclaimers, mobile touch targets). Undermined by devices-first clutter, incomplete honesty surface on “today” meal cards, fragile health loading, and several dead paths in a ~5.5k-line `profil.js`.

---

## P0 — Critical (trust / broken primary loop)

### 1. Today meal cards present kcal as exact; weekly PlanViewer uses “cca”
| | |
|---|---|
| **Evidence** | `ProfileDayMealsPanel.js` L71–72: `{nutrition.calories} kcal` (no hedge). `ProfileTodayPanels.js` L147: hero uses `cca … kcal`. `PlanViewer.js` L444–445: weekly pills use label `cca`. |
| **Why P0** | After calorie-honesty work, the primary logged-in surface still implies plate-exact numbers while other surfaces hedge. Users who only use “Dnešní jídla” get a different truth contract. |
| **Recommendation** | Unify on `cca N kcal` (or shared helper) everywhere meals are shown; optionally show macro-consistency warning when `getMacroCalorieDelta` is `ERROR`. |

### 2. Macro kcal `ERROR` never shown in UI
| | |
|---|---|
| **Evidence** | `MacroRatioChart.js` L22–29: `ERROR` → `console.warn` only. L60–62: UI warning only for `WARNING`. Used from today panels + PlanViewer. |
| **Why P0** | Honesty gate (±10%) exists in `lib/macroKcalConsistency.js` but the profile UI hides hard inconsistency. |
| **Recommendation** | Surface ERROR in Czech (“Makra a kcal si neodpovídají”) on meal cards and recipe modal; don’t rely on console. |

---

## P1 — High (UX honesty gaps, clutter, error handling)

### 3. Calorie-honesty under-target not reflected in today hero / meal list
| | |
|---|---|
| **Evidence** | PlanViewer: banner + `· zatím pod cílem` (`PlanViewer.js` L1279–1305, L1547–1548, L1737–1738). `ProfileTodayPanels.js`: no `calorie_under_target` / shortfall / honesty import (grep empty). Hero shows `cca X / cíl Y` without under-target cue (L146–148). |
| **Recommendation** | Pass `getPlanCalorieHonestyStatus` / day flags into `ProfileTodayPanels`; mirror banner meta + “zatím pod cílem” on day sum. |

### 4. Devices + full Apple Watch stack sit above “Můj plán”
| | |
|---|---|
| **Evidence** | `profil.js` L2405–2427: `ConnectDevicesSection` + always-on `AppleWatchSection` before mindset/plan (L2498+). Empty charts still render (`HealthLineChart` empty state; `RecoveryCard` empty). |
| **Why P1** | Primary product goal is meal/training plan; unconnected users scroll past heavy health chrome first (esp. mobile). |
| **Recommendation** | Collapse to compact CTA when disconnected; deep-link to `/dashboard/zdravi` or expand-in-place; keep plan first. |

### 5. Health API: one failure wipes all health UI
| | |
|---|---|
| **Evidence** | `hooks/useHealthData.js` L41–53: `Promise.all` of 6 endpoints; any throw → `setData(INITIAL)` + single error. |
| **Recommendation** | `Promise.allSettled`; keep partial data; per-section errors. |

### 6. Recipe modal “Na 1 porci” vs scaled meal macros
| | |
|---|---|
| **Evidence** | Modal label L1998: `Na 1 porci`. Open path passes `displayModel.calories` (may already include `portion_multiplier`) into `/api/recipe-from-catalog` (`PlanViewer.js` L626–627). Ingredients often catalog base. |
| **Recommendation** | Label “Podle tvé porce v plánu” when `portion_multiplier ≠ 1`, or show base + scaled side-by-side. |

### 7. Orphan health dashboard vs inline duplicate
| | |
|---|---|
| **Evidence** | `HealthProfileEntry.js` links to `/dashboard/zdravi` but is **not imported** by `profil.js`. Full `AppleWatchSection` is inlined on profile; dashboard page duplicates it (`pages/dashboard/zdravi.js`). |
| **Recommendation** | Wire entry OR remove orphan; prefer one canonical health surface. |

### 8. “Kdy mám trénink?” for all clients (trainer calendar)
| | |
|---|---|
| **Evidence** | `profil.js` L2763–2779: calendar bubble for every non-trainer client; copy assumes trenér / Google Calendar / info@. Empty/disconnected states common for self-serve START. |
| **Recommendation** | Show only when schedule connected or VIP/ON_CLUB with trainer; else hide or replace with plan-workout CTA. |

### 9. Grammar / copy bug on workout restore
| | |
|---|---|
| **Evidence** | `ProfileTodayPanels.js` L90, L97: `Nepodařilo obnovit trénink` (missing **se**). |
| **Recommendation** | Fix to `Nepodařilo se obnovit…`. |

### 10. Preferences overlay English badge (i18n rule break)
| | |
|---|---|
| **Evidence** | `PreferencesOverlay.jsx` L62: `AI personalization workspace`. |
| **Recommendation** | Czech label consistent with rest of overlay. |

### 11. Estimated workout kcal next to nutrition kcal (trust mixing)
| | |
|---|---|
| **Evidence** | Heuristic `WORKOUT_TYPE_SPECS` + `estimatedCalories` in `profil.js` L76–91, L212–222; KPI `~{estimatedCaloriesThisWeek}` / “orientační kcal” L3046–3048 (title-only disclaimer). Intake uses structured meal kcal elsewhere. |
| **Recommendation** | Keep “orientační” visible in the value line; never imply Watch active energy = logged workout estimate. |

### 12. Workout duration heuristic shown as fact-ish
| | |
|---|---|
| **Evidence** | `ProfileTodayPanels.js` L122: `exercises.length * 8` minutes when `duration_minutes` missing; shown as `~N min` L172, L218. |
| **Recommendation** | Prefer omit / “délka dle plánu” when duration unknown. |

---

## P2 — Medium / polish / dead paths

### 13. Dead / contradictory first-action banner
| | |
|---|---|
| **Evidence** | L2396–2400: requires `showReadyBanner && !currentPlan`. `showReadyBanner` ⇒ `plan_state === 'ready'` (`usePlanStatus.js` L24–26); ready almost always implies a selectable plan (`planSelection.js`). Copy says “Tvůj plán je připraven” while `!currentPlan`. |
| **Recommendation** | Delete or fix condition to `showReadyBanner && currentPlan` (and only if plan section collapsed). |

### 14. Dead code in `profil.js`
| | |
|---|---|
| **Evidence** | `PROGRAM_LABELS` L47–51 — never referenced. `handleGenerateNextWeek` / `generatingNextWeek` L397, L1704–1728 — never used in JSX. |
| **Recommendation** | Remove or wire to UI. |

### 15. Accordion `max-height: 5000px` risk outside plan
| | |
|---|---|
| **Evidence** | L4204–4214: open bubbles capped at 5000px; only `#muj-plan` uses `max-height: none` (L4217–4219). Stats/calendar/history could clip if content grows. |
| **Recommendation** | Same `max-height: none` pattern for heavy sections, or height: auto. |

### 16. XSS surface via `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`
| | |
|---|---|
| **Evidence** | Mindset + coach message: `profil.js` L2454, L2491 (coach only does `\n` → `<br>`). |
| **Recommendation** | Sanitize server-side / DOMPurify if content isn’t fully trusted. |

### 17. `image_trust_level` computed, never labeled in meal UI
